claims.value: Qwen3.5-4B is a Causal Language Model with Vision Encoder, using a 4B parameter hybrid architecture (Gated Delta Networks and sparse MoE). It supports early fusion multimodal learning, integrates reinforcement learning from million-agent environments, and covers 201 languages/dialects. The model features a hidden dimension of 2560 and 32 layers, designed for high-throughput inference with minimal latency.
